changelog:
PHTVC 1.2 Stable Highlights:
• Audio Focus music auto-pause integration
• 5-Minute background inactivity auto-exit
• Collapsible Philippine & International channels sections
• Real-time system volume and brightness sync
• Rover and Phrolova core theme presets
• Player error screens with full gesture blockers
updateMessage: PHTVC 1.2 Stable is now available with audio focus background music auto-pausing, 5-minute auto-exit, hardware volume/brightness slider sync, collapsible categories, and Rover/Phrolova custom themes.
